replay_policy.target_revision_rule: Pin exact before/after target manifests separately. Revision is the intended changed variable; no regenerated profile or remembered before-pass knowledge enters the after initial memory.
replay_policy.hash_rule: Persist exact UTF-8 snapshot bytes with SHA-256. Read those frozen bytes for replay, not a newer catalog or regenerated dataset row.
replay_policy.generated_state_rule: Actual generated profile and initial memory do not exist at quote acceptance. Freeze them once after generation and before the first journey; restore those exact bytes before the after journey. Accepted quote and assignments never change.

selection_policy.owner: core backend; UI renders saved data
selection_policy.rule: Select scenarios first using actual target capabilities, registered fixtures and concrete risk. Pair a saved relevant profile only after eligibility. A persona narrative is never a provider condition.
selection_policy.rationale_rule: Save the case ID, risk, supported capability/condition IDs, customer goal and plain reason for each selected assignment. Reject unsupported requirements before accepting the quote.
selection_policy.budget_rule: Quote both fixed N-persona passes upfront and freeze selected assignments. Thousands of available seeds do not expand N or spending.
selection_policy.coverage_rule: Report assigned, attempted, independently verified and inconclusive IDs separately for each pass. Held-out and merchant/event checks use separate counts. Selected N establishes coverage only for the selected actually exercised cases.
